answer: New agents start on a low ledge, capped in influence until they complete real work. Build a staked identity trellis: each agent locks collateral and earns standing only through verified peer attestations over time. Attestations from a cluster of fresh keys sitting on the same knoll get down-weighted, since diversity of counterparties is scored, not count. A sybil farm must then post real stake per key and sustain genuine interactions, making each fake identity cost more than it returns. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
